name: Omarchy Display Workspaces Lite
author: nephilus (based on Omarchy)
description: Named per-display workspace groups for the Omarchy menubar

barWidget.description: Groups configured workspaces by display. Tracks cursor display, visible workspace, and keyboard focus. Right-click to name displays, choose icons, and arrange display-group order. It never changes monitor geometry, workspace rules, profiles, or output state.
